samples.targetText:
executor
    .select({
      entitlementId: entitlements.entitlementId,
      entitlementStatus: entitlements.entitlementStatus,
      externalRef: entitlements.externalRef,
      startsAt: entitlements.startsAt,
      updatedAt: entitlements.updatedAt,
    })
    .from(entitlements)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(entitlements.isCurrent, true),
        eq(entitlements.ownerId, context.ownerId),
        eq(entitlements.accountId, context.accountId),
        eq(entitlements.appId, context.appId),
        context.appScopeId === null
          ? isNull(entitlements.appScopeId)
          : eq(entitlements.appScopeId, context.appScopeId)
      )
    )
    .orderBy(desc(entitlements.updatedAt)).limit
